description: The canonical map from integers to fraction classes is injective and preserves addition, multiplication, zero, one, and order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integer_rational_embedding :
  (Function.Injective fun z => Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑z) ∧
    (∀ (a b : ℤ),
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalAdd (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑a)
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑b) =
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑(a + b)) ∧
      (∀ (a b : ℤ),
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalMul (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑a)
              (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑b) =
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑(a * b)) ∧
        (∀ (a b : ℤ),
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.RationalLE (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑a)
                (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑b) ↔
              a ≤ b) ∧
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat 0) = 0 ∧
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalOfRat 1) = 1
